title: Shopping on Saturday
text:
Lucy goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs milk, bread and apples. The shop is near her house. Apples are cheap today, so she buys a big bag.

At the till, Lucy pays with a ten-pound note. The woman gives her some change and a receipt. Lucy puts the receipt in her bag. She is happy because the shopping is not expensive.

questions.text: Where does Lucy go on Saturday?
What does Lucy pay with at the till?
How does Lucy probably feel after her shopping?
Why does Lucy probably keep the receipt?
options: She wants proof of what she bought
She wants to give it to a friend
She wants to write a letter

vocabulary.definition: money you get back when you pay more than the price
the place in a shop where you pay
a paper that shows what you paid

paragraph_translations: Lucy idzie do sklepu w sobotę. Potrzebuje mleka, chleba i jabłek. Sklep jest blisko jej domu. Jabłka są dziś tanie, więc kupuje dużą torbę.
Przy kasie Lucy płaci banknotem dziesięciofuntowym. Pani daje jej trochę reszty i paragon. Lucy wkłada paragon do torby. Jest szczęśliwa, bo zakupy nie są drogie.
